FramePlayer

A native VR video player for the Valve Steam Frame. 180°, 360°, fisheye, SBS/OU, HDR, subtitles, and your existing DeoVR-compatible library.

Install in under two minutes

  1. On the headset: Settings → System → Developer Mode (one time).
  2. Pair the headset with Frame Control or FrameDrop on your computer (one time).
  3. Click a button below. FramePlayer appears under Library → Non-Steam with its artwork.
Install with Frame Control Install with FrameDrop

Loading release details…

Other ways to install

Command line (macOS, Windows, Linux): download frameplayer-install from the latest release, then run frameplayer-install pair and frameplayer-install install.

After the first install FramePlayer updates itself from inside the headset. Full guide: docs/install.md.
